verses.en: When the LORD thy God hath cut off the nations, whose land the LORD thy God giveth thee, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their cities, and in their houses;
verses.pt: Quando o SENHOR teu Deus exterminar as nações, cuja terra o SENHOR teu Deus dá a ti, e tu as herdares, e habitares em suas cidades, e em suas casas;
verses.en_web: When Yahweh your God cuts off the nations whose land Yahweh your God gives you, and you succeed them and dwell in their cities and in their houses;
verses.en_bbe: When the nations, whose land the Lord your God is giving you, have been cut off by him, and you have taken their place and are living in their towns and in their houses;

verses.en: Thou shalt separate three cities for thee in the midst of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.
verses.pt: Separarás três cidades em meio de tua terra que o SENHOR teu Deus te dá para que a possuas.
verses.en_web: you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the middle of your land, which Yahweh your God gives you to possess it.
verses.en_bbe: You are to have three towns marked out in the land which the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage.

verses.en: Thou shalt prepare thee a way, and divide the coasts of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to inherit, into three parts, that every slayer may flee thither.
verses.pt: Prepararás o caminho, e dividirás em três partes o termo de tua terra, que o SENHOR teu Deus te dará em herança, e será para que todo homicida se fuja ali.
verses.en_web: You shall prepare the way, and divide the borders of your land which Yahweh your God causes you to inherit into three parts, that every man slayer may flee there.
verses.en_bbe: You are to make ready a way, and see that the land which the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage, is marked out into three parts, to which any taker of life may go in flight.

verses.en: And this is the case of the slayer, which shall flee thither, that he may live: Whoso killeth his neighbour ignorantly, whom he hated not in time past;
verses.pt: E este é o caso do homicida que há de fugir ali, e viverá: o que ferir a seu próximo por acidente, que não lhe tinha inimizade nem recente nem em passado distante:
verses.en_web: This is the case of the man slayer who shall flee there and live. Whoever kills his neighbor unawares, and didn’t hate him in time past;
verses.en_bbe: This is to be the rule for anyone who goes in flight there, after causing the death of his neighbour in error and not through hate;

verses.en: As when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood, and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slippeth from the helve, and lighteth upon his neighbour, that he die; he shall flee unto one of those cities, and live:
verses.pt: Como o que foi com seu próximo ao monte a cortar lenha, e pondo força com sua mão no machado para cortar alguma lenha, saltou o ferro do fim, e encontrou a seu próximo, e morreu; aquele fugirá a uma daquelas cidades, e viverá;
verses.en_web: as when a man goes into the forest with his neighbor to chop wood and his hand swings the ax to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the handle and hits his neighbor so that he dies, he shall flee to one of these cities and live.
verses.en_bbe: For example, if a man goes into the woods with his neighbour for the purpose of cutting down trees, and when he takes his axe to give a blow to the tree, the head of the axe comes off, and falling on to his neighbour gives him a wound causing his death; then the man may go in flight to one of these towns and be safe:

verses.en: Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer, while his heart is hot, and overtake him, because the way is long, and slay him; whereas he was not worthy of death, inasmuch as he hated him not in time past.
verses.pt: Não seja que o parente do morto vá atrás do homicida, quando se arder seu coração, e o alcance por ser longo o caminho, e o fira de morte, não devendo ser condenado à morte; porquanto não tinha inimizade nem recente nem em passado distante com o morto.
verses.en_web: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue the man slayer while his heart is hot and overtake him, because the way is long, and strike him mortally; even though he was not worthy of death, because he didn’t hate him in time past.
verses.en_bbe: For if not, he who has the right of punishment may go running after the taker of life in the heat of his wrath, and overtake him because the way is long, and give him a death-blow; though it is not right for him to be put to death because he was not moved by hate.

verses.en: Wherefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt separate three cities for thee.
verses.pt: Portanto eu te mando, dizendo: Três cidades separarás.
verses.en_web: Therefore I command you to set apart three cities for yourselves.
verses.en_bbe: And so I am ordering you to see that three towns are marked out for this purpose.

verses.en: And if the LORD thy God enlarge thy coast, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, and give thee all the land which he promised to give unto thy fathers;
verses.pt: E se o SENHOR teu Deus alargar teu termo, como o jurou a teus pais, e te der toda a terra que disse a teus pais que havia de dar;
verses.en_web: If Yahweh your God enlarges your border, as he has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land which he promised to give to your fathers;
verses.en_bbe: And if the Lord your God makes wide the limits of your land, as he said in his oath to your fathers, and gives you all the land which he undertook to give to your fathers;

verses.en: If thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them, which I command thee this day, to love the LORD thy God, and to walk ever in his ways; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee, beside these three:
verses.pt: Quando guardasses todos estes mandamentos, que eu te prescrevo hoje, para praticá-los, que ames ao SENHOR teu Deus e andes em seus caminhos todos os dias, então acrescentarás três cidades a mais destas três;
verses.en_web: if you keep all this commandment to do it, which I command you today, to love Yahweh your God, and to walk ever in his ways; then you shall add three cities more for yourselves, besides these three.
verses.en_bbe: If you keep and do all these orders which I give you today, loving the Lord your God and walking ever in his ways; then let three more towns, in addition to these three, be marked out for you:

verses.en: That innocent blood be not shed in thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance, and so blood be upon thee.
verses.pt: Para que não seja derramado sangue inocente em meio de tua terra, que o SENHOR teu Deus te dá por herança, e seja sobre ti sangue.
verses.en_web: This is so that innocent blood will not be shed in the middle of your land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, leaving blood guilt on you.
verses.en_bbe: So that in all your land, which the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage, no man may be wrongly put to death, for which you will be responsible.

verses.en: But if any man hate his neighbour, and lie in wait for him, and rise up against him, and smite him mortally that he die, and fleeth into one of these cities:
verses.pt: Mas quando houver alguém que aborrecer a seu próximo, e o espreitar, e se levantar sobre ele, e o ferir de morte, e morrer, e fugir a alguma destas cidades;
verses.en_web: But if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies, and he flees into one of these cities;
verses.en_bbe: But if any man has hate for his neighbour, and waiting for him secretly makes an attack on him and gives him a blow causing his death, and then goes in flight to one of these towns;

verses.en: Then the elders of his city shall send and fetch him thence, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.
verses.pt: Então os anciãos de sua cidade enviarão e o tirarão dali, e o entregarão em mão do parente do morto, e morrerá.
verses.en_web: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.
verses.en_bbe: The responsible men of his town are to send and take him, and give him up to the one who has the right of punishment to be put to death.

verses.en: Thine eye shall not pity him, but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with thee.
verses.pt: Não lhe perdoará teu olho: e tirarás de Israel o sangue inocente, e te irá bem.
verses.en_web: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall purge the innocent blood from Israel that it may go well with you.
verses.en_bbe: Have no pity on him, so that Israel may be clear from the crime of putting a man to death without cause, and it will be well for you.

verses.en: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour’s landmark, which they of old time have set in thine inheritance, which thou shalt inherit in the land that the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.
verses.pt: Não reduzirás o termo de teu próximo, o qual assinalaram os antigos em tua herança, a que possuíres na terra que o SENHOR teu Deus te dá para que a possuas.
verses.en_web: You shall not remove your neighbor’s landmark, which they of old time have set, in your inheritance which you shall inherit, in the land that Yahweh your God gives you to possess.
verses.en_bbe: Your neighbour's landmark, which was put in its place by the men of old times, is not to be moved or taken away in the land of your heritage which the Lord your God is giving you.

verses.en: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sinneth: at the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be established.
verses.pt: Não valerá uma testemunha contra ninguém em qualquer delito, ou em qualquer pecado, em qualquer pecado que se cometer. No dito de duas testemunhas, ou no dito de três testemunhas consistirá o negócio.
verses.en_web: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall a matter be established.
verses.en_bbe: One witness may not make a statement against a man in relation to any sin or wrongdoing which he has done: on the word of two or three witnesses a question is to be judged.

verses.en: If a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him that which is wrong;
verses.pt: Quando se levantar testemunha falso contra alguém, para testificar contra ele rebelião,
verses.en_web: If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing,
verses.en_bbe: If a false witness makes a statement against a man, saying that he has done wrong,

verses.en: Then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges, which shall be in those days;
verses.pt: Então os dois homens litigantes se apresentarão diante do SENHOR, diante dos sacerdotes e juízes que forem naqueles dias:
verses.en_web: then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before Yahweh, before the priests and the judges who shall be in those days;
verses.en_bbe: Then the two men, between whom the argument has taken place, are to come before the Lord, before the priests and judges who are then in power;

verses.en: And the judges shall make diligent inquisition: and, behold, if the witness be a false witness, and hath testified falsely against his brother;
verses.pt: E os juízes investigarão bem, e se parecer ser aquela testemunha falsa, que testificou falsamente contra seu irmão,
verses.en_web: and the judges shall make diligent inquisition: and behold, if the witness is a false witness, and has testified falsely against his brother;
verses.en_bbe: And the judges will have the question looked into with care: and if the witness is seen to be false and to have made a false statement against his brother,

verses.en: Then shall ye do unto him, as he had thought to have done unto his brother: so shalt thou put the evil away from among you.
verses.pt: Fareis a ele como ele pensou fazer a seu irmão: e tirarás o mal do meio de ti.
verses.en_web: then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
verses.en_bbe: Then do to him what it was his purpose to do to his brother: and so put away the evil from among you.

verses.en: And those which remain shall hear, and fear, and shall henceforth commit no more any such evil among you.
verses.pt: E os que restarem ouvirão, e temerão, e não voltarão mais a fazer uma má coisa como esta, em meio de ti.
verses.en_web: Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you.
verses.en_bbe: And the rest of the people, hearing of it, will be full of fear, and never again do such evil among you.

verses.en: And thine eye shall not pity; but life shall go for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
verses.pt: E não perdoará teu olho: vida por vida, olho por olho, dente por dente, mão por meio, pé por pé.
verses.en_web: Your eyes shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
verses.en_bbe: Have no pity; let life be given for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
